sloka: विमुक्तमिव मायाभिरस्त्रैरिव बहिष्कृतम् ।मामवज्ञाय दुर्बुद्धे स्वया बुद्ध्या विचेष्टसे ।। ६.१०६.३ ।।
transliteration: vimuktamiva māyābhirastrairiva bahiṣkṛtam ।māmavajñāya durbuddhe svayā buddhyā viceṣṭase ।। 6.106.3 ।।

translations.english: "You dullard! Disdaining me as not capable, lacking manliness, powerless, deficient in valour, timid, incapable, petty, devoid of energy, not knowing conjuring tricks, abandoned weapons, driven out, you act not knowing me in your own way foolishly using your discretion."
